torus_piston.name: Wheel / cylinder / torus
torus_piston.label: Wheel / cylinder / torus
torus_piston.description: An exposed finite connecting rod converts wheel rotation into a 1.60 m horizontal stroke. A white cylinder with red bands enters a stationary pink torus. Ideal kinematics, not simulated force or pumping.
torus_piston.qfep_connection: An observable constraint distinguishes actual movement from apparent movement. A shared input does not imply an independent animation.

pillar_barber_roll.name: Pillar / pink red white barber roll
pillar_barber_roll.label: Pillar / pink red white barber roll
pillar_barber_roll.description: A pink/red/white helical sleeve physically rotates around a stationary structural pillar. No band moves vertically: a fixed witness makes the apparent climb and real rotation visible.
pillar_barber_roll.qfep_connection: An observable constraint distinguishes actual movement from apparent movement. A shared input does not imply an independent animation.
